review.decision: Require current data that can benefit from the optional move
review.notes: The current installer leaves a fresh root in the default flat mode. A v2 marker, startup leases, or empty scaffolding are also insufficient evidence of useful work. A verified v3 journal and matching marker establish completion. A marker or directory alone cannot establish completion or invite a fresh move.

cases.description: Fresh installation and empty v2 scaffolds have no migration notice
cases.setup: Use temporary homes with a fresh root, an empty opted-in v2 root, and v2 with only nested empty directories and empty registered locks.
cases.action: Run ordinary Doctor and inspect its report and the original layout.
cases.expected: Doctor does not advertise a workflow migration and does not create a new workflow marker. Existing populated v2 coverage still offers the optional move.

cases.description: Doctor distinguishes verified completion from stray or inconsistent layout evidence
cases.setup: Use a completed v3 layout, a standalone marker, and a verified v3 layout with a re-created original path.
cases.action: Run ordinary Doctor and inspect the results.
cases.expected: A verified complete layout displays v3 without a migration offer. A stray marker or unexpected inactive store reports its validation error without a new migration offer.
